findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: login_existing_account, list_apps, send_push_notification, configure_rss_autopush, check_billing_and_qris_status · Private data: register_new_account, login_existing_account, create_app, update_app_branding, delete_app, send_push_notification, configure_payment_webhook, list_subscribers, send_transactional_email · Public sink: register_new_account, login_existing_account, send_push_notification, configure_inapp_banner, configure_rss_autopush, configure_payment_webhook, create_qris_invoice, configure_social_toast, configure_email_automation, send_transactional_email · Destructive: create_app, delete_app, schedule_push_notification, list_subscribers, update_subscriber_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: login_existing_account, list_apps, send_push_notification, configure_rss_autopush, check_billing_and_qris_status · Private data: register_new_account, login_existing_account, create_app, update_app_branding, delete_app, send_push_notification, configure_payment_webhook, list_subscribers, send_transactional_email · Public sink: register_new_account, login_existing_account, send_push_notification, configure_inapp_banner, configure_rss_autopush, configure_payment_webhook, create_qris_invoice, configure_social_toast, configure_email_automation, send_transactional_email · Destructive: create_app, delete_app, schedule_push_notification, list_subscribers, update_subscriber_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
